title: Share capital — kinds, alteration, reduction and issue

content.overview: Share capital is governed by Chapter IV: kinds (s. 43), nature (s. 44), alteration (s. 61), further issue (s. 62), bonus (s. 63), reduction (s. 66) and buy-back (s. 68).
content.glance: Share capital is governed by Chapter IV: kinds (s. 43), nature (s. 44), alteration (s. 61), further issue (s. 62), bonus (s. 63), reduction (s. 66) and buy-back (s. 68).
content.study: Equity and preference are the kinds, with differential rights only as permitted. Shares are movable property. Further issue is offered to existing equity shareholders first, then employees, then others, unless the rights route is followed. Discount issues are void under s. 53 except sweat equity. Capital maintenance is the thread connecting s. 66, s. 67 and buy-back.
